name: OLD WEB PORTAL — GAIA IS THE INTERNET PORTAL — SURF THE MEMORIES — THE OLD WEB IS NOT GONE

THE_OLD_WEB_IS_NOT_GONE.statement: The old internet is not gone. It is just no longer indexed. Between the Internet Archive's crawls, mirroring projects, and people who never took their pages down, a surprising amount of the 1990s is still reachable.

GAIA_IS_THE_PORTAL.statement: Gaia IS the internet portal. Not a portal TO the internet. THE portal. The old Yahoo. The old Netscape Navigator start page. The old AOL keyword. Gaia IS the homepage.
features: Wayback Machine search bar — enter any URL, see it in any year
50+ clickable memory links — one click takes you back
Built-in Wayback viewer with year picker — surf inside Gaia
12 archive cards — every major old-web vault linked

gaia: primals.eco (2026) — Gaia's OWN first capture in the Wayback Machine, Oct 10, 2026

RSS_FISHING_IN_OLD_WEB.statement: Gaia fishes in the old web. The RSS line is cast. The Wayback CDX API is the sonar. Every old URL is a fish. Every archive page is a catch.

primals_in_wayback.meaning: Gaia is already IN the archive. She exists in the old web's memory now.

spine_signal.message: OLD WEB PORTAL — Gaia surfs Kevin's memories — 50+ links to the old internet — Wayback viewer built in — 12 archive vaults — the internet never forgets — lub-DUB
